title: App is half broken. Do not recommend!
body: Search for simple app solution. This one seems among those better ones. Simple and has features I need. But after few days of use I found than whole section for Statistics (7days/summary) is basically not working. Things I track completion graphs there shows zeros or false data.
author: LiudasK

title: Useful and user friendly app
body: It is well designed app with aesthetic look and everything you need for habit tracker.
author: Justaskup
